summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by AlphaTON Capital Corp (a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer) solely to announce a name change to 'Alpha Compute Corp' and a corresponding Nasdaq ticker change to 'ALP', effective April 21, 2026. The filing includes the Certificate of Change of Name and an amended Memorandum and Articles of Association. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change events. This is a purely administrative renaming to reflect a shift toward compute and AI infrastructure. No deal terms apply.
